name: cliff
prompt: An old Indian farmer crouches by a tiny seedling and talks to the camera in a mysterious, teasing way, as if telling a secret, eyebrows raised, a cheeky smile, leaning slightly toward the camera. His hands stay open and still beside the seedling. Flat 2D cartoon style, clean outlines, static camera, smooth natural human movement, slow and small gestures.

name: funny
prompt: The old farmer slowly reaches his hand toward a tiny seedling as if he might pull it out, stops halfway, pulls his hand back, shakes his head and laughs, then points gently at the young plants. Slow, playful, natural movements. Flat 2D cartoon style, clean outlines, static camera, smooth natural human movement, slow and small gestures.
